instruction: Follow artists of all the songs and albums I have ever liked on Spotify.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. The concrete liked songs/albums are unknown up front, so the problem uses a representative instance: two liked songs (artist-1, artist-2) and one liked album (artist-3); the static song-artist/album-artist facts describe the world structure, while knowledge is tracked by liked-songs-listed / liked-albums-listed (effects of the list calls) and known-id (effect of show_song / show_album, which reveal the artists). Without conditional effects a single list call cannot reveal multiple ids, so the list calls set a flag and show_song/show_album are parameterized by (item, artist); a song/album with several artists would be modeled with one show-* step per artist (same API call, repeated bookkeeping). Pagination of show_liked_songs/show_liked_albums is collapsed into one action each (the executor should iterate page_index until an empty page). follow_artist requires (not (following ?ar)) so shared artists are followed only once, matching the evaluation (added followings == union of artists of liked songs and albums, nothing removed). Since the goal is a conjunction over several artist records and quantified goals are disallowed, supervisor-complete-task carries the three followed artist records as non-API parameters with pairwise inequality so its precondition mirrors the problem goal exactly; the API call itself takes no answer (status success).
